dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Seka loader ya Vulkan: ka Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Ka Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Ka RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
